thread:
Dana: Quick readout — ran parallel quant runs (int6 vs int8) on zebra-13b across 3 slices: short-chat, long-summarization, rerank. TL;DR: int6 ~42% cost savings, int8 ~25% savings. Latency: int6 p95 +12% on short-chat, int8 p95 +4%. Quality: short-chat ~no perf loss on intent, summarization has ~2.3 point ROUGE drop and some hallucination uptick on int6.

Jin: infra looked stable. KV cache hit-rate identical across runs, default batch size 8 kicked in for short-chat. No OOMs.

Leila: looked at the summaries — int6 introduces more terse endings and a handful of factual flips in long context. Multi-turn recall drops on prompts with >3 turns. I'll run targeted priming ablation.

Maria: Product question — safe traffic % for a GTN pilot? We need a concrete rollout plan and stop conditions.

Dana: Proposal: (a) Short-chat endpoints: canary int6 at 5% initially, ramp to 20% if metrics stable. (b) Long-summarization: hold int6 at 0% until priming fixes; allow int8 at 20% as baseline. (c) Rerank: prefer int8 (lower risk). Use automatic fallback to int8/fp16 on quality flags.

Jin: Ops knobs: add rule-based fallback by QA score + latency SLO. Suggested p95 latency budget = 300ms for short-chat. Also enable tracing headers for every request in the pilot.

Leila: Eval plan: A/B for 14 days with these metrics: helpfulness (human), hallucination rate, user-rated satisfaction, cost per 1k tokens, latency p50/p95. Sample sizes: 1k unique conversations per slice. I’ll run a 1k human eval on the worst-case slice first.

Dana: Quick rollout config snippet for the canary:```yaml
routes:
  - name: gtn-short-chat
    weights:
      int8: 0.8
      int6: 0.2
    failover: int8
    latency_slo_ms: 300
```

ops-bot: Canary scheduled by ops for 2026-03-25T15:00Z. Duration: 14 days. Automated alerts: trigger if quality_score drops >1.5% vs baseline or hallucination rate +0.5pp.

Maria: Product OK with that plan. I’ll reserve the GTN cohort and add analytics tag `experimental-quant`. Will notify support for potential user reports.

Dana: Action items — Leila: run priming ablation + 1k human eval (due Tue). Jin: implement fallback + tracing + alert thresholds. Maria: assign GTN cohort and wire analytics tag. I’ll collect metrics and post a results summary next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
